chunks: Say: It has been revealed to me
that a number of jinns had listened
then said: 'We have heard the wondrous Qur'an,
ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad (SAW) receive regarding the jinns listening to the Qur'an?
ai.summary: This verse from Surah Al-Jinn (72:1) reveals that a group of jinns listened to the Prophet Muhammad (SAW) reciting the Qur'an in Mecca, marking a unique instance of non-human beings receiving divine guidance. Shia scholars often highlight this event as evidence of the Qur'an's universal scope and the Prophet's role as a mercy to all worlds, including the unseen realm. The 'wonder' (ajaban) they expressed underscores the transformative power of the divine message, which led to their immediate submission and return to their people as warners.
